import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.CoherentSubmodule
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivLocallyClosed
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.LocallyFreeCoherence
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.QuasicoherentKernel
import AlgebraicJacobian.Projective.Grassmannian

/-!
# Coherence of the universal divisor candidate

The ambient Grassmannian over a field is locally noetherian. Its universal
curve is therefore locally noetherian for a curve of finite type. These are
the noetherian inputs for coherence and relative flattening of the universal
candidate in the divisor construction leading to Kleiman's main theorem.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

open CategoryTheory Limits

universe u

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.LocallyFreeQuotient

variable {S X : Scheme.{u}} {π : X ⟶ S} {T : Over S}

/-- The cokernel reconstructed from a Grassmannian quotient is quasi-coherent.
The kernel on the base is quasi-coherent, pullback preserves quasi-coherence,
and the candidate is the cokernel of its evaluation on the total space. -/
theorem candidateQuotient_isQuasicoherent
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsQuasicoherent]
    [((Modules.pushforward π).obj L).IsQuasicoherent] {d : ℕ}
    (q : LocallyFreeQuotient ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) d T) :
    (cokernel (kernelEvaluation L q)).IsQuasicoherent := by
  haveI : q.F.IsQuasicoherent := q.locFree.isQuasicoherent
  haveI : ((Modules.pullback T.hom).obj ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L)).IsQuasicoherent :=
    pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom T.hom _ inferInstance
  haveI : (kernel q.q).IsQuasicoherent :=
    Modules.kernel_isQuasicoherent q.q inferInstance inferInstance
  haveI : ((Modules.pullback (pullback.snd π T.hom)).obj
      (kernel q.q)).IsQuasicoherent :=
    pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom _ _ inferInstance
  haveI : ((Modules.pullback (pullback.fst π T.hom)).obj L).IsQuasicoherent :=
    pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom _ _ inferInstance
  exact Modules.cokernel_isQuasicoherent (kernelEvaluation L q) inferInstance inferInstance

/-- The candidate ideal is quasi-coherent on the entire base-changed family,
before imposing any divisor or flatness condition. -/
theorem candidateIdeal_isQuasicoherent
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsQuasicoherent]
    [((Modules.pushforward π).obj L).IsQuasicoherent] {d : ℕ}
    (q : LocallyFreeQuotient ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) d T) :
    (candidateIdeal L q).IsQuasicoherent := by
  haveI := candidateQuotient_isQuasicoherent L q
  haveI : ((Modules.pullback (pullback.fst π T.hom)).obj L).IsQuasicoherent :=
    pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom _ _ inferInstance
  exact Modules.kernel_isQuasicoherent (candidateQuotient L q) inferInstance inferInstance

/-- On a locally noetherian total space, the candidate ideal of a finitely
presented sheaf is finitely presented, as a quasi-coherent submodule of its
pullback. -/
theorem candidateIdeal_isFinitePresentation
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsFinitePresentation]
    [((Modules.pushforward π).obj L).IsQuasicoherent] {d : ℕ}
    (q : LocallyFreeQuotient ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) d T)
    [IsLocallyNoetherian (pullback π T.hom)] :
    (candidateIdeal L q).IsFinitePresentation := by
  haveI := candidateIdeal_isQuasicoherent L q
  haveI : ((Modules.pullback (pullback.fst π T.hom)).obj L).IsFinitePresentation :=
    Modules.pullback_isFinitePresentation _ L inferInstance
  let i : candidateIdeal L q ⟶
      (Modules.pullback (pullback.fst π T.hom)).obj L :=
    kernel.ι (candidateQuotient L q)
  haveI : Mono i := by
    dsimp only [i, candidateIdeal]
    infer_instance
  exact Modules.isFinitePresentation_of_mono i

/-- The universal candidate quotient has the finite-presentation input needed
for relative flattening, without assuming that it is already a divisor. -/
theorem candidateQuotient_isFinitePresentation
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsFinitePresentation]
    [((Modules.pushforward π).obj L).IsQuasicoherent] {d : ℕ}
    (q : LocallyFreeQuotient ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) d T)
    [IsLocallyNoetherian (pullback π T.hom)] :
    (cokernel (kernelEvaluation L q)).IsFinitePresentation := by
  haveI := candidateQuotient_isQuasicoherent L q
  haveI : (kernel (candidateQuotient L q)).IsQuasicoherent :=
    candidateIdeal_isQuasicoherent L q
  haveI : ((Modules.pullback (pullback.fst π T.hom)).obj L).IsFinitePresentation :=
    Modules.pullback_isFinitePresentation _ L inferInstance
  haveI := candidateQuotient_epi L q
  exact Modules.isFinitePresentation_of_epi (candidateQuotient L q)

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.LocallyFreeQuotient

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Grassmannian

/-- The chosen Grassmannian over a field is locally noetherian, since its
H-quasi-projective morphism to the field is locally of finite type. -/
instance representingScheme_isLocallyNoetherian_of_field
    {k : Type} [Field k]
    {V : (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).Modules} {r d : ℕ}
    (hV : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank V r)
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdr : d ≤ r) :
    IsLocallyNoetherian (representingScheme hV hd hdr).left := by
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (representingScheme hV hd hdr).hom :=
    (representingScheme_isHQuasiProjective_of_field hV hd hdr).locallyOfFiniteType
  exact LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian
    (representingScheme hV hd hdr).hom

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Grassmannian
